O. N. H. OWENS, Chairman W. J. G. MACDIARMID, Director 


IN THE LAURENTIANS 


THE MONTREAL Y.M.C.A. CAMP FOR BOYS 
Camp address 
from June 20th:— 
KANAWANA P.O., Que. 
November 7, 1938 
1441 Drummond St. 


Kanawana Goes on the Air 


This is to remind you of the rehearsal for the Kanawana 
feature on the "Voice of Youth Program" this weeke The re- 
hearsal will be held in the Willingdon Room on the second 
floor of the Central Branch Y.M.C.A., 1441 Drummond St., at 
6.30 o'clock to-morrow, Tuesday, November 8th. We will re- 
hearse for awhile at the "Y" and then slip across the street 
to C.BeM. Studios for a few minutes longer. We should be 
all through shortly after 8 o'clock. 


The broadcast will be held on Thursday night at 7.15 
o'clock over Station C.B.Me Tell your friends so that they 
can listen in and hear you over the air. 

Will be looking for you to-morrow night. 


Sincerely yours, 


CHIEF
